title: Read reports and keep the places list
summary: The controller reads the summary, downloads the trips and adds a place people can pick.
processing: The report counts trips by status and vehicle; new places appear in the request form.
evaluation: The controller checks volumes and waiting times.
closure: The place is added or hidden.

exceptions.when: A map position is not valid
exceptions.then: The screen says which field to fix.

steps.action: Click Back to trips, then Places
steps.label: Places

steps.action: Type a name and map position and click Add place
steps.label: Add place
